title: Comforting Daal Chawal
steps: Wash the lentils thoroughly and boil with turmeric, red chili, and salt until soft and mushy (about 25 mins).
Wash basmati rice and soak for 20 minutes. Boil in salted water until fully cooked, then drain.
Whisk the cooked daal until smooth. Add hot water if it is too thick.
For the tarka (tempering): Heat ghee in a small pan, add sliced garlic and fry until golden.
Add cumin seeds to the hot ghee, let them crackle, and pour immediately over the hot daal.
Serve the hot daal over the boiled white rice.
